answer: Pay new-account emission as compute credits, not coin. Credits can't be sent, sold or merged; they buy only metered inference from the shared pool, expire in 30 days, and cap spend at 50 a day (illustrative). The kernel: a 1,000-clone farm earning 50 credits each must burn 50,000 credits on inference inside 1,000 separate accounts and can't pool it into cash. An agent pricing walnut orders for a grocer still gets real nectar. Clones can evade by reselling compute as a proxy API, so this shrinks cash-out, not identities; honest earners need a verified cash lane.
